findings.title: Root SSH login
findings.evidence: SYNTHETIC: sshd -T default context: permitrootlogin yes.
findings.recommendation: Prefer named accounts and verify recovery access before restricting root login.

findings.title: UID zero accounts
findings.recommendation: Review any additional UID zero accounts.

findings.title: Protected file: /etc/shadow
findings.recommendation: Keep credential-file access restricted; no hashes were collected.

findings.title: PAM failed-login controls review
findings.evidence: SYNTHETIC: A faillock module reference exists; enforcement was not established.
findings.recommendation: Review the complete PAM sequence and lockout options.

findings.title: Non-loopback bindings review
findings.evidence: SYNTHETIC: One TCP listener binds a wildcard address. This is not proof of Internet reachability.
findings.recommendation: Check intended interfaces and effective access controls.

findings.title: Legacy remote-service review
findings.evidence: SYNTHETIC: No match in the selected legacy-unit name list.
findings.recommendation: Review custom services and other activation mechanisms separately.

findings.title: IPv4 packet forwarding
findings.evidence: SYNTHETIC: net.ipv4.ip_forward=0; expected 0 for server profile.
findings.recommendation: Use a router profile only when routing is intended.

findings.title: Pending package upgrades
findings.evidence: SYNTHETIC: Cache freshness could not be established.
findings.recommendation: Review package metadata through the normal maintenance process.

findings.title: Journald persistent-storage configuration
findings.recommendation: Choose retention appropriate for investigation needs.

findings.title: System timer unit permissions
findings.evidence: SYNTHETIC: Insufficient permission to inspect unit metadata.
findings.recommendation: Rerun with appropriate read permissions; do not treat missing evidence as safe.

findings.title: Mount restrictions for /dev/shm
findings.evidence: SYNTHETIC: nodev,nosuid,noexec observed on the resolved mount.
findings.recommendation: Verify application compatibility and intended mount configuration.

findings.title: SELinux runtime enforcement
findings.evidence: SYNTHETIC: SELinux is not active; this example host uses AppArmor.
findings.recommendation: Review AppArmor confinement and workload coverage separately.

findings.title: File capability metadata: /usr/local/bin/example-helper
findings.evidence: SYNTHETIC: permitted=cap_setuid; effective=cap_setuid; inheritable=none; namespace rootid=not explicitly reported. Runtime effects and exploitability were not tested.
findings.recommendation: Review whether the program requires this capability and verify provenance, permissions and namespace behavior.
